# 2 bed apartment for sale

> Introduction An excellent opportunity to acquire a bright and generously proportioned two-bedroom apartment in the popular Tannery development on Cork Street. Situated on the first floor and enjoying its own-door entrance, this impressive apartment offers well-balanced accommodation with excellent natural light throughout.
